items.html: The general conclusion is that the first Hey of the Name is the single name SAG, including ten Sefirot, internality and externality, and is called Tevuna. Within it there are three first [Sefirot] called Bina, and six extremities called Tevuna; and the Malchut within it is called Tevuna, and the externality of Netzach-Hod-Yesod of this Malchut is also called Tevuna.
